strengths.point: Promoters hold a controlling majority - skin in the game.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
Foreign institutions have been cutting their stake.
Domestic institutions have been cutting their stake.

opportunities.point: Management stated that the company can easily double its revenue on a year-to-year basis for the next two years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "That is very easily achievable in the next two years. For the next two years, that guidance I can give we can easily develop the top line by 100% on a year-to-year basis." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management targeted that e-commerce business will contribute at least 12% to 14% to the overall top line in the current year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, we are hopeful that overall e-commerce business will contribute at least 12 to 14% overall top line in this year." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that the company expanded from 43 stores as of March 31, 2025, to around 111 stores as of April 30, 2026.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "As I mentioned, we expanded from 43 stores as on 31st March 2025 to around 111 stores as at 30th April, 2026." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management noted that the company opened its 100th store at Lawrence Road.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "If you're not aware, we opened our 100th store at Lawrence Road, which is one of the premium high streets in that region, and got a very decent mileage for that opening." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management noted that the kids' market has immense growth potential in Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "And the potential to grow our plan in Tier 1 and Tier 2 is immense." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management observes immense gaps and positive growth prospects in the kids premium fashion category.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "talking about the gross prospect we see an immense gap in the premium, Kids premium fashion as a category." (concall transcript - 2026-01-01)

opportunities.point: Management reported that the D2C website receives daily orders of roughly 300 orders per day.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "And if we talk of numbers, we are getting daily orders of roughly 300 orders per day, and we are very hopeful that in another 3 to 4 months we will be touching a 4-digit order number from our website only." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The mother warehouse has a 30,000 square feet facility supplying goods to all channel partners.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "It's a 30,000 square feet facility, is our mother warehouse from where we are supplying goods to all our channel partners, which is EBOs." (concall transcript - 2026-01-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that the company is hopeful of reaching a database of roughly 1 million customers in 5 to 6 months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Currently, we have around 2 lakh customer bases, and we are hopeful that in another 5 to 6 months we will be having a database of roughly 1 million customers for better customer engagement." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: Management stated that the company expects to touch a 4-digit daily order number from its website only in another 3 to 4 months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "And if we talk of numbers, we are getting daily orders of roughly 300 orders per day, and we are very hopeful that in another 3 to 4 months we will be touching a 4-digit order number from our website only." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: Management stated that the company expects to be operationally cash positive in another 12 to 18 months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, we are very hopeful going by the past trend. So, you mentioned that we have already done an improvement. So, we are very hopeful that we should be operationally cash positive maybe another 12 to 18 months." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: Management stated that CRISIL assigned the company a BBB- Stable rating, which is an investment-grade rating.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "We have recently been rated by CRISIL, which will be BBB- Stable rating, which is an investable grade rating." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -5.5 pp, DII -1.99 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management noted that expansion in the Middle East was deferred due to unfavorable current market dynamics and the war situation.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "We participated in an event in the Middle East also, and we would have loved to expand in the Middle East, but the current market dynamics, current macro environment is not supporting. Let the things stabilize, I think then we'll be able to take a call on..." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Business processes are becoming more complex, requiring senior hiring and marketing expenditures as the store count exceeds 100.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "on the other side, since the business processes are becoming more complex, we are hiring senior person also, and with the 100-plus stores, we'll have to spend some amount in marketing also." (concall transcript - 2026-01-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S2/W5/O27/T8), led by 'Management stated that the company can easily double its revenue on a year-to-year basis for the next two years', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
